description: This file defines models and logic for managing timesheets, attendance, and related reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including custom views, constraints, and business rules for timesheet validation and attendance tracking.

classes.name: one2many_mod2
classes.description: Custom one2many relation with date filtering based on current user and date.

classes.name: one2many_mod
classes.description: Custom one2many relation with date filtering based on current user.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet
classes.description: Main timesheet sheet model with methods for validation, navigation, and state management.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_line
classes.description: Analytic timesheet extension with additional logic for sheet association and validation.

classes.name: hr_attendance
classes.description: Attendance model extension with sheet association and validation.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet_sheet_day
classes.description: View model for timesheets aggregated by period, auto-generated SQL view.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet_sheet_account
classes.description: View model for analytic accounts aggregated by timesheet, auto-generated SQL view.

classes.name: res_company
classes.description: Company extension adding timesheet range and maximum allowed difference settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve related records filtered by current date and user for one2many relation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set related records with context including sheet ID.

methods.name: _total_day
methods.description: Compute total attendance, timesheet, and difference per sheet.

methods.name: _total
methods.description: Compute total attendance and timesheet for sheets.

methods.name: _state_attendance
methods.description: Determine current attendance state for sheets based on employee data.

methods.name: check_employee_attendance_state
methods.description: Validate that sign-in and sign-out counts are equal before validation.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Validate attendance counts and trigger workflow to confirm timesheet.

methods.name: date_today
methods.description: Set current date to today or sheet boundaries.

methods.name: date_previous
methods.description: Navigate to previous date within sheet range.

methods.name: date_next
methods.description: Navigate to next date within sheet range.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Reset current date to sheet start or end.

methods.name: sign_in
methods.description: Record sign-in for employee if date matches today.

methods.name: sign_out
methods.description: Record sign-out for employee if date matches today.

methods.name: _get_default_date
methods.description: Default date for timesheet lines and attendance based on context or current date.

methods.name: _sheet
methods.description: Determine associated timesheet sheet for a line or attendance.

methods.name: _sheet_search
methods.description: Search for timesheet sheets matching criteria for lines or attendance.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Ensure timesheet or attendance modification is allowed based on sheet state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Create SQL views for timesheet aggregation by day and account.
